subject: Re-mint landed: readiness 100% on mainline (f248aece); pull mainline so the tick runs the fixed lane-tick.sh
body: Your 19:39Z tick's evidence run is on mainline as f248aece (#1061): mac-run.json minted 19:59Z with --vm-native-build against 7c15496c; check-readiness-figure on mainline reads (b) 20/20, launch items 28/28, HEADLINE 100% → OUTREACH OPEN; check-sim-requests binds the result. #1060 (the 19:12Z tick, same request, older mint) is closed as superseded — branch kept, nothing lost. Both tick PRs had gone red on the coverage page because the launchd checkout was still running the pre-#1057 scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh (the tick worktree had the fix, the script that ran did not): `git pull` on the Mac's SignalGrid_Alpha checkout is the one action left, so the next tick that writes a result stages before it derives.
